pass_a_gloss: I-will-worship toward temple holy of-you in fear of-you. Temple holy is of-the God the Christ, because the God was in Christ world reconciling to-himself. In the fear of-God turns-aside every-one from evil; in fear of-Lord he-worships the temple, which is Christ: Destroy for, he-says, the temple this, and in three days I-will-raise it.
pass_b_english: “I will worship toward your holy temple in your fear” (Psalm 5:8).

A holy temple of God is Christ, because “God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself” (2 Corinthians 5:19). In the fear of God everyone turns aside from evil (Proverbs 16:6); and in the fear of the Lord he worships the temple, which is Christ: for “Destroy this temple,” he says, “and in three days I will raise it” (John 2:19).

choices.why: Lock prints ναὸν α γιόν: OCR split of ἅγιόν, not υἱόν. The lemma is holy temple, not temple of the Son.

choices.term: Ναὸς ἅγιός ἐστι τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ Χριστός
choices.english: A holy temple of God is Christ
choices.why: Predicate is Christ; τοῦ Θεοῦ depends on ναός. Not ‘the temple is the Son of God, Christ’.
rejected: the temple is the Son of God, Christ
Christ is the Son of the holy temple

choices.why: John 2:19 λύσατε τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον is Destroy this temple, not Loose.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
